summary.text: Nicole Cole is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 66th District, which covers part of Caroline County and part of Spotsylvania County, and has served since January 14, 2026.
Cole sits on the House committees on Finance; Counties, Cities and Towns; and Health and Human Services.

paragraphs.text: Nicole Cole was born in Hampton, VA, according to the House profile.

The profile lists Cole's education as Highland Springs High School (diploma); University of Maryland College Park (Bachelor of Science in Business Management, December 1991); Northwestern University, Kellogg School of Business Management (Master of Business Administration in Finance and Health Services Management, June 1997).
The profile gives Cole's occupation as financial advisor.

Cole's listed memberships and affiliations include Alpha Kappa Alpha Sorority Inc. (Xi Upsilon Omega chapter); Fredericksburg Chamber of Commerce (business member); VA Black Chamber of Commerce (business member); Pathways to Success Foundation, Inc. (board president); HELP Consulting (board member).
